spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (-नयते)
To go, to move: see णय and णी.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Fit, right, proper.
2 Leading, conducting, (who or what does so.)
m. (-यः)
1 Guiding, directing, (literally or figuratively, as in morals, &c.)
2 Polity, civil and military government.
3 The theological part of the

Vedas.
4

A sort of dice or men for playing with.
5 A guide, a conductor.
E.
नय to go, affix घञ्, or णी to guide, &c. affix अच्.

m. (-यः)
1 Guiding, directing, (morally or physically.)
2

Policy.
3

Obtaining.
4

Means, expedient.
E.
णी to guide, &c. affix ण or घञ्; also with अच् affix नय.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Leading, guiding.
2 Tending or conducing to.
3 Informing, certifying, giving in evidence.
4 Obtaining.
E.
णी to obtain, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 The eye.
2 Leading, guiding, (literally or figuratively.)
3 Attaining, obtaining.
4 Bringing.
f. (-ना)
The pupil of the eye.
E.
णी to guide, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-रि)
Tears.
E.
नयन, and वारि water.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Sight-stealing, blinding.
E.
नयन, and आमोषिन् what steals.

m. (-वः)
1 A lamp.
2 Any lovely or desired object.
E.
नयन the eye, and उत्सव a festival.

m. (-न्तः)
The outer angle or canthus of the eye.
E.
नयन, and उपान्त extremity.

m. (-धः)
Green sulphate of iron, or the salt in a state of partial decomposition by exposure to the atmosphere.
E.
नयन the eye, and औषध a medicament, being used as a collyrium.

f. (-ठी)
The board or cloth on which dice or men are played.
E.
नय dice, पीठी a stool.

m. (-गः)
Policy, political address.
E.
नय, and प्रयोग application.

m. (-दः)
A politician, a statesman.
E.
नय, and विशारद skilled in.

f. (-द्धिः)
Political success, accomplishing any thing by good management.
E.
नय, and सिद्धि success.

m. (-कः)
1 A guide, a leader, a conductor.
2 A chief, a head, pre-eminent, principal.
3 A general, a commander.
4 The central gem of a necklace.
5 (In Erotick poetry,) The man, the husband or lover.
f. (-यिका)
1 A mistress, a wife, the female in the amatory poetry of the

Hindūs.
2

A sort of goddess, an inferior form of DURGĀ, and attendant upon her: there are eight Nāyikās.
E.
णी to guide, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-पः)
A king, a sovereign prince.
E.
नायक a chief, and अधिप lord.
